tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Strains used in this study.
footnotes: All strains were cultured in Cation Adjusted Mueller-Hinton medium. In the case of S. pneumoniae, this medium was complemented with 2.5% lysed horse blood. The strains are listed alphabetically and according to their use in the figures.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Antibiotic sensitivity of Staphylococcus capitis and strains used in Figures 2, 3.
footnotes: Empty cells indicate that the given antibiotic was not tested. I (yellow), partially resistant; R (orange), fully resistant; S (green), sensitive. Antibiotic sensitivity was determined using the Vitek 2 apparatus (Biomérieux, Marcy-l'Etoile, France) for all strains except Burkholderia and Stenotrophomonas, the antibiotic sensitivity of which was tested using Agar diffusion tests with Kirby-Bauer medium. The background colors used in the “Strains” column refer to the grouping shown in Table 1.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Antibiotic sensitivity of clinical isolates of Acinetobacter baumanii and Pseudomonas aeruginosa (used in Figure 4).
footnotes: Empty cells indicate that the given antibiotic was not tested. I (yellow), partially resistant; R (orange), fully resistant; S (green), sensitive. Antibiotic sensitivity was determined using the Vitek 2 apparatus (Biomérieux, Marcy-l'Etoile, France).
